title: Petra and the Rivergate
premise: Storm chaser Ivo Winterbourne, drowning in debt to the optimistic loan sharks of the Meridian Syndicate, salvages a river chest bearing the seal of Vellmark, a nation erased from maps forty years ago. Inside are land deeds proving the Syndicate's river concessions were built on forged grants, making Ivo the most wanted man between the lowlands and the pass. Pursued by Syndicate enforcers and a government assessor who wants the deeds buried, Ivo gathers an unlikely crew—a disgraced cartographer, a Vellmarki exile, and a runaway toll-keeper's daughter—and races the first snows across the range to reach the capital before the concession permits renew. He arrives with hours to spare, files the deeds, and loses the money, the chase, and his invisibility, but gains the one thing twenty years of miles never gave him: people who stay.
about_author: Rafael Thornbury is the pen name of a former river surveyor who spent a decade mapping waterways that no longer appear on official charts. He writes adventure novels from a houseboat he refuses to register in any one jurisdiction.

chapters.title: The Optimists
chapters.summary: POV Ivo. After a storm chase goes wrong, Ivo faces the Meridian Syndicate's cheerful enforcers, who give him thirty days to repay or forfeit his rig and his health. The chapter establishes his debts, his restlessness, and his creed of never staying anywhere long enough to be found. Emotional beat: the loneliness he mistakes for freedom.

chapters.title: What the River Kept
chapters.summary: POV Ivo. Fishing the flooded shallows after a storm, Ivo's dredge snags a lead-lined chest stamped with Vellmark's sunburst seal. Inside: deeds, letters, and a map of the range passes. He recognizes the Syndicate's watermark on a forged grant and understands what he's holding. Emotional beat: dread curdling into a reckless, unfamiliar hope.

chapters.title: A Cartographer's Regret
chapters.summary: POV Odile Vasse, the disgraced cartographer Ivo once betrayed to save his own rig. He finds her drinking in a border town and offers her the one thing she can't refuse: the chance to correct a map she falsified under Syndicate orders. She agrees, but doesn't forgive him. Emotional beat: guilt offered a second chance and not knowing what to do with it.

chapters.title: The Exile of Vellmark
chapters.summary: POV Sera Ilves, an old Vellmarki exile running a mountain waystation, who confirms the deeds are genuine—and that her people were dispossessed by the very concessions the Syndicate now holds. She joins the expedition as guide, carrying her father's ashes and forty years of grief. Emotional beat: the quiet ferocity of someone with nothing left to lose.

chapters.title: The Assessor
chapters.summary: POV Corin Hale, a government assessor ordered to retrieve the deeds quietly and make the problem disappear. Hale intercepts the party at the toll bridge, where he meets Nessa, the toll-keeper's daughter who has been secretly overcharging the Syndicate for years and slips the party past him. Emotional beat: a man of duty discovering the law he serves has a price tag.

chapters.title: Nessa's Toll
chapters.summary: POV Nessa. She abandons the toll house and joins the party, bringing the Syndicate's own ledger of bribes as leverage. The enforcers burn the bridge behind them, cutting off retreat. Ivo, who planned to travel alone, realizes he has a crew. Emotional beat: found family assembling itself against his will, and his terror of it.

chapters.title: The High Pass
chapters.summary: POV Odile. The snows come early; the party must take the unmapped pass Odile once falsified off the charts. Using her old crime as a guide, she leads them through, but an enforcer ambush costs Sera her father's ashes and nearly costs Nessa her life. Emotional beat: atonement purchased with blood, and Odile finally forgiving herself mid-storm.

chapters.title: What Ivo Owes
chapters.summary: POV Ivo. Trapped in a waystation with the enforcers closing in, Ivo offers himself in exchange for the crew's passage—repaying his debts the only way he knows: alone. But the crew refuses to let him go, and Hale, arriving to arrest them, instead arrests the enforcers after reading Nessa's ledger. Emotional beat: Ivo learning that loyalty is a debt you can't pay off, only carry.

chapters.title: The Last Mile to the Capital
chapters.summary: POV Hale. With permits expiring at dawn, the party and Hale race the Syndicate's lawyers to the registry. The Syndicate offers Hale a promotion to bury the deeds; he files them instead, then resigns. The concessions void, the enforcers scatter, and the Vellmarki claims enter the courts. Emotional beat: justice achieved not by heroes but by a bureaucrat choosing a conscience.

chapters.title: Miles and Years
chapters.summary: POV Ivo. Spring: the waystation rebuilt, Sera's father's ashes returned to Vellmarki soil, Nessa running a new toll that charges no one, Odile drawing honest maps. Ivo sells his rig, buys a house with walls, and for the first time measures his life in years instead of miles. Emotional beat: the storm chaser finally coming home.
